about: Manual lane-state labels from visual inspection of outputs/lanes/visual_check/sheet_*.jpg (image + BDD100K GT lane lines + direct/alternative drivable). laneCount = travel lanes in the ego direction of travel (lanes occupied or partly hidden by vehicles count; parking lanes, shoulders, bike lanes and opposite-direction lanes do not). currentLane is numbered from the left. null = not decidable from one frame (intersection, parking lot, unmarked wide road, lane change / straddling, too dark). 'ambiguous' = a reasonable reader could disagree; 'acceptable' lists the other defensible [laneCount, currentLane] readings. Labelled by the lanes agent (Claude) on 2026-09-25; single annotator, no second opinion.
